primitives.name: Platform Aspect Ratio Compliance
primitives.verbatim_quote: ```bash higgsfield generate create gpt_image_2 \ --image "$BRANDKIT_WORKDIR/logo/approved-logo-2048.png" \ --image "$BRANDKIT_WORKDIR/reviews/approved-typography.png" \ --prompt "<exact social graphic prompt>" \ --aspect_ratio 3:4 \ --resolution 4k \ --wait --json ``` Omit the typography reference for a no-text graphic and use only live-schema ratio/resolution values.
primitives.assumptions: R is fixed per platform and A is determined by resolution settings.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R = 3:4 for standard poster; special handling for 4:5 feed posts.

layer2.mapping: GSI constraint enforces R = 3:4 for GPT Image 2; GSE applies cropping for 4:5.
layer2.telemetry: Final graphic meets specified aspect ratio and resolution requirements.
